scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Cocos?
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
你打完了50只可可吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放弃

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
嗯，我觉得你还没打到50只...

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Remember, I need help hunting Cocos so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
记住，我需要你帮忙打可可，快去打50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
你确定要停止狩猎吗？
你目前的进度将会被清除

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
好吧，如果你改变主意了，随时回来找我。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
真厉害，你完成得这么快。

[Nutters]
I..I just can't seem to find any.
Pesky Coco's have hidden all the Acorns.
Do you think you could help me?
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
我...我怎么都找不到。
可恶的可可把橡果都藏起来了。
你能帮帮我吗？

scripts.text: Sure

scripts.text: No

Oh, that's great! I knew I could count on you, just from looking at you!

[纳特斯]

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Can you help me find ^00CE0025 Acorns^000000.
I will reward you with much if you can.
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
你能帮我找^00CE002525个橡果^000000吗？
如果你能找到的话，我会给你丰厚的奖励。

scripts.text: I have 25 Acorns
scripts.translation: 我有25个橡果

scripts.text: Please come again?
scripts.translation: 请稍后再来？

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Oh great you found out where they were hiding them.
Gimme Gimme!!!
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
太好了，你找到了它们藏身的地方。
快给我快给我！！！

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Oh that's right, sorry I just love roasting Acorns. Mmm.
Here is what I promised you.
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
啊对了，抱歉，我只是太喜欢烤橡果了。嗯。
这是答应给你的东西。

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
Where are my ^00CE00Acorns^000000?
Hey, I'm not playing, you better not hold out on me.
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
我的^00CE00橡果^000000呢？
喂，我没在开玩笑，你最好别想赖账。

scripts.text:
[Nutters]
I need ^00CE0025 Acorns^000000.

[Nutters]
Ah, ok I think you can help me out by hunting some Cocos.
How many would you like to hunt?
scripts.translation:
[纳特斯]
啊，好吧，我觉得你可以帮我打一些可可。
你想打多少只？

scripts.translation: 50只可可

scripts.translation: 100只可可
